stories.headline: This App Brutally Shames You by Tracking How Many Hours You’ve Lost to Scrolling
stories.dek: The iOS app Oh My Hours takes a new approach to curbing screen time. It splits up your day into hour-long blocks, then shows which ones you wasted on Instagram and TikTok.

stories.headline: AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says — but first, it will spend big
stories.dek: Amazon wants to be the king of AI cloud computing and become the first $1 trillion revenue business. But to do that it will have to continue on its capex spending spree, its CEO said Thursday.

stories.headline: Maine’s data center revolt will decide who controls the Senate
stories.dek:
Maine Sen. Susan Collins, a Republican, was midway through defending her record during the final debate of the midterms when an audience member cut her short.
"I'm terrified," a man shouted. "AI data centers are destroying our climate. They are poisoning our water."  Collins brushed off the outburst

stories.headline: Fan-fiction site Archive of Our Own (AO3) could be offline for up to 4 weeks after security incident
stories.dek: The site has such a passionate user base that, within two hours of the announcement, its status page's posts had garnered millions of views (and much panicked commentary) across social media.

stories.headline: Meta quietly launches an AI fashion app called Style Sketch
stories.dek: The app connects to Instagram to build a virtual closet from photos you’ve already shared, or lets you add items manually by snapping a photo, recording a quick video, or uploading images from your camera roll.

stories.headline: US investigated Chinese spy plot aimed at Nvidia CEO
stories.dek: A top executive of a Singapore AI cloud company that was accused of illegally selling Nvidia chips to China could also have been a Chinese spy, sources have told the New York Times.
